name: Nozaki Nana
source:
Kanpaku Sengen :

[Yuri's best friend]
A servant at the Sonoda residence where "Sonoda Yuri" lives.

As a servant at Yuri's house, she does housework and other chores. Suspicious of
Akira's behavior, Yuri racks her brains trying to think of a way to keep an eye on him, and as a result, Nana emerges as someone who has no ties to the Sonoda family, is unrelated to the candidates for CEO, and is also cooperative.

She is appointed as Akira's secretary and assigned to "Sonoda Trading Co., Ltd."
While performing chores as instructed, she regularly monitors Akira's condition and reports to Yuri. Generally, she is excellent and acts on her own judgment in most cases, but she has a tendency to get carried away and is not good at reading the mood, such as when she takes over Takatsuki's work.

Akira sees through her intention to keep an eye on him and uses her instead.


Gyaku Oudou :

[Ryuuji's Mother]

She is the same person as Nana, the heroine of "Declaration of Indifference".
She had a son, Ryuuji, with Toudou Akira, but they were not married. She raised Ryuuji while working as Akira's servant.

She thought, "I want Ryuuji to live out his life as a normal human being if possible," but when Ryuuji caught Akira's eye, she gave up and decided to let him walk the path of being a candidate to succeed the head of the Sonoda Foundation.
